name: TOB Reading Plan
description: One reading plan (e.g. 'Bible Stories for Little Hearts', a 7-day Kids plan). Admin-authored content, browsed by every logged-in user via truth_of_bible.api.reading_plan (never raw REST for a normal user — see that module's docstring). A plan's actual daily readings live in TOB Reading Plan Day, one row per day, linked back here.

fields.label: Age Group
fields.options:
Kids
Teens
Young Adults
Adults
Seniors
All Ages
fields.description: Who this plan is written for — the app's Reading Plans hub filters/groups by this.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Only Published plans are ever returned to the app.

fields.label: Duration (days)
fields.description: Shown on the plan card before its days are loaded. Should match the number of TOB Reading Plan Day rows for this plan, but isn't enforced automatically — update it if you add/remove days.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower shows first within the plan's age group on the hub screen.

fields.label: Icon
fields.options:
auto_stories
child_care
school
favorite
nights_stay
self_improvement
menu_book
volunteer_activism
fields.description: A fixed icon key the Flutter app maps to a real icon — keeps every plan card visually consistent instead of allowing arbitrary icon input.

fields.label: Accent Color

Amber
Blue

Purple

fields.description: A fixed palette key the Flutter app maps to its own theme-aware colors — same reasoning as Icon.
